title: "Session 5 — Regression preview"
author: "Prof. Dae-Jin Lee (daelee@faculty.ie.edu)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
ci <- read_csv("data/country_indicators.csv")
```

```{r}
fit <- lm(life_expectancy ~ gdp_per_capita, data = ci)
coef(fit)
# years associated with +10000 GDP/capita
coef(fit)[2] * 10000

ggplot(ci, aes(gdp_per_capita, life_expectancy)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
```

**Associational reading only:** countries with +\$10k GDP/capita tend to have ~1.85 years higher life expectancy *in this sample fit*.
